newsitem.title: USA: Fort Lauderdale, Fla., airport expansion approved.
newsitem.headline: Fort Lauderdale, Fla., airport expansion approved.

text.p: Florida's Broward County Commisson approved an agreement with City of Fort Lauderdale for a $1.2 billion expansion of Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport.

approved Tuesday, the agreement will allow the county to obtain building permits needed to build a new terminal, parking garage and road system. In exchange, Fort Lauderdale will get $8.5 million worth of roads and parks.
The agreement was needed because a small portion of airport land is within city boundaries.
Construction is to begin later this summer.
The county is still negotiating with City of Hollywood for permission needed to extend one of the airports runways to at least 9,000 feet.
